Pronunciation-only slips left out per S4: خندرة for كندرة (10:31, chat kundara), بيكميس for قميص (10:08), Shufik for أشوفك (1:02:02), Kamara/Tawamara for 'كمان مرة'. coverage.r2: 00:00-06:26 is English chat about a song; Amal's Arabic there is redacted as [foreign language], so the 03:22-03:57 words (loaf, yard) cannot be recovered - only two asked-rows written from his Latin (balad/bilad, Sakit). 06:26-10:49 is the only speaking stretch (date, time, weather, clothes). 11:13-1:00:35 is a listening drill: Amal says a sentence, Medi gives the English - so most rows are mode=listening and 'wrong' is his English reading. r3_note: 00:00-06:26 is English chat about a song (one didn't-know at 03:44, D11). 06:26-10:40 is his short speaking warm-up (date, time, weather, clothes). 11:13-1:00:35 is a listening drill: Amal says a sentence, he reads it aloud in English, and she types the target 30-120 s later; in that stretch she types EVERY sentence, so a chat line alone is never a fix signal. Her 50:01 'Or انبسطت له' with chat 'enbasa6tillo / enbasa6etlo' means she offered BOTH the I-form and the she-form, so his 'She was happy' at 50:18 is not a slip; only the preposition was (D7).
